static_fit.detail: 222 uncovered and223 cap snapshots are distinct. Covered height -0.75, tie side -0.05 and front root0.2296875 are already baked. Requested values are retained in the choice records. Never deform the uncovered tail through the cap.

materials.lens: Opacity1/transmission1/IOR1.25/roughness0.025. Closed manifold double-sided geometry. KHR_materials_transmission and KHR_materials_ior carry optical intent; no volumetric thickness extension. This is not painted alpha. Frames/lenses are independent.
materials.taper: Authored RGBA is baked into standard COLOR_0 on every relevant primitive, including secondary materials. Preserve BLEND coverage and transparent depth/sorting; never use an opaque dummy channel.
materials.colors: PBR/vertex factors are linear RGB. Preserve declared PNG/HDR/embedded-texture color spaces; avoid double sRGB conversion.
